name: Suspension-feeding benthos
description: Functional group pooling the source's 'other suspension feeders' compartment (barnacles, hooked mussels and other filter-feeding bottom life) with the soft-shell clam Mya arenaria, because both are benthic filter feeders with near-identical diets in the source flow matrix. Reported biomass (metrics.biomass) is the summed annual mean in mgC/m2.
